newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba sees profit in consumer products in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba sees profit in consumer products in 97/98.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Thursday its group consumer products division would turn a profit in the business year starting in April after nearing break-even point in the current business year.
"We expect the division's operating loss to be close to the break-even point in the current business year, and for the division to make money next year," said a Toshiba spokesman.
The improvement was attributed to reduced costs resulting from a shift of production overseas and the introduction of new models, such televisions and camcorders, the spokesman said.

The Toshiba group's consumer products division, which includes electrical appliances and chemical products, has posted an operating loss for the last four business years, including a loss of 29.3 billion yen in 1995/96.
